edits.why: maude-v2 scopes its tokens to .maude-v2[data-theme] (the .maude scope would no longer match), and its core components (callout, card, dialog, checkbox) only apply under :where(.ds).

notes: To apply by hand: the three Close buttons (artboards compare, overlay, conflict) use className="btn btn--icon dv-close". maude-v2 has no btn--icon; its icon button is .icon-btn. The line is identical three times, so it is not listed as a single-match edit: replace 'btn btn--icon dv-close' with 'icon-btn dv-close' in all three.
Decision: .panel (3 uses, panel dv-sheet) has no maude-v2 rule; closest is .island (ext.Island). The local dv-sheet styling keeps the sheet visible.
Decision: callout--info has no tone in maude-v2 (Callout variants are all null). Base .callout applies under .ds; the info tint is lost unless DiffView.css adds it.
Line heights change from fixed px to ratios (DiffView.css uses --lh-* twice): text runs slightly tighter.
maude-v2's :root default is light; this canvas sets data-theme="dark" explicitly, so it stays dark.

Comments only: DiffView.css lines 3 and 210 still mention system/maude. The design is 'handed-off' (handoffCommit 97859dc); DiffView.registry.json describes the maude build until the handoff is redone.
